name: Sleepio (SleepioRx)
one_liner: A 6-week digital CBT-I program for chronic insomnia, available as FDA-cleared SleepioRx by prescription or as Sleepio via some employers.
best_for: Adults with chronic insomnia who want CBT-I without seeing a sleep specialist in person
People whose clinician can prescribe SleepioRx, including Medicare patients
People whose employer or health plan offers Sleepio
not_for: People with possible untreated sleep apnea, until they have been tested
People without a prescriber, employer benefit or plan that offers it: there is no self-pay option on the vendor site
Anyone in crisis: call or text 988
short_description: Digital CBT for insomnia from Big Health: weekly app sessions, a sleep diary and a personalised sleep schedule; SleepioRx is FDA-cleared and.
long_description: Sleepio is a self-guided cognitive behavioral therapy for insomnia (CBT-I) program from Big Health. Over about six weeks you work through app sessions covering sleep restriction, stimulus control, managing racing thoughts and relaxation, and keep a sleep diary that sets your sleep window. In the US the prescription version, SleepioRx, is FDA-cleared for adults 18 and over: a clinician orders it and you get an access code by text. Since January 2025 clinicians can bill Medicare for it under digital mental health treatment codes, with usual Medicare coinsurance. The non-prescription Sleepio app is offered through some employers and plans; Big Health lists no self-pay price. Sleepio has been tested in several large randomised trials, including a 2019 JAMA Psychiatry trial of 1,711 adults and the 2017 OASIS trial of 3,755 students in Lancet Psychiatry, both showing improved insomnia compared with sleep hygiene education or usual care.
patient_summary: You work through about six weeks of short app sessions on CBT-I techniques and keep a nightly sleep diary that sets your sleep schedule. In the US you get SleepioRx through a clinician's prescription (Medicare can cover it) or Sleepio through an employer or health plan; there is no public self-pay price.

pricing.starting_price: Free through your employer or plan; SleepioRx by prescription (Medicare coinsurance applies)
pricing.notes: SleepioRx is ordered by a licensed clinician with an access code; clinicians can bill Medicare codes G0552–G0554 since January 2025, with standard 20% coinsurance under traditional Medicare. Big Health publishes no self-pay price.

privacy.notes: Big Health privacy notice (read 2026-10-27) says it may 'sell' or 'share' data via advertising cookies and pixels on its corporate website and lets ad partners collect identifiers and activity data for interest-based ads; deletion requests offered to all users regardless of location.

seo.title: SleepioRx: FDA-Cleared CBT-I for Insomnia | HeyPsych
seo.meta_description: Sleepio is an FDA-cleared digital therapeutic delivering CBT-I (cognitive behavioral therapy for insomnia) through a 6-week app-based program.

faqs.a: Yes, clinical trials published in peer-reviewed journals show 76% of Sleepio users achieve normal sleep. The program is based on CBT-I, which is recommended as first-line treatment for chronic insomnia by the American Academy of Sleep Medicine. Results are comparable to in-person CBT-I therapy.

faqs.q: How long does Sleepio take to work?
faqs.a: The core program is 6 weeks with weekly sessions. Many users see improvement within 2-3 weeks, though sleep often gets temporarily worse during sleep restriction before improving. Full benefits typically appear by week 4-6.

faqs.q: Is Sleepio better than sleeping pills?
faqs.a: Medical guidelines recommend CBT-I (what Sleepio delivers) as first-line treatment before medication. CBT-I addresses root causes while pills mask symptoms. CBT-I has no side effects and benefits persist after treatment ends—unlike medication dependence.

Check if your employer or health insurance covers Sleepio. Major partners include CVS Health, Express Scripts, and many large employers. Some health systems also prescribe Sleepio. Contact HR or check your benefits portal. Direct individual purchase isn't currently available.
